data.gender_notes: Murawwat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Murawwat is a name of Arabic origin meaning Flexible, Adaptable. It is derived from the Arabic word ‘Murawwah’ which means adaptability. This name is suitable for a child who is expected to be flexible and adaptable in life. The name Murawwat carries the meaning “Flexible, Adaptable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Murawwat usually hope their child will grow to embody flexible, adaptable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Murawwat is a name with deep spiritual meaning in Islam. It symbolizes the ability to adapt to changing circumstances and remain steadfast in faith. The name is also a reminder of Allah’s infinite mercy and forgiveness, as He is always ready to forgive and adapt to our mistakes and shortcomings.
data.etymology: Murawwat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flexible, Adaptable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murawwat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
